regressions: Both Runtime and tool-call widgets abort an in-flight terminal-state read on navigation, then refresh old cached facts exactly once on actual RunBody reentry.
Success updates the displayed facts; permanent and bounded-retry failures preserve prior facts with explicit error/stale notices.
Cold initial reads remain single requests; same-page LiveAttempts remounts and unrelated runs.all invalidation do not reload diagnostics.
Closed and inactive participant fact caches are marked stale without reads; another Run, local participant selection and unfetched queries are excluded.
1000 attempts and 3000 closed widget/selection queries require at most three cache passes, with zero cold-entry invalidations and one warm-entry batch; no wall-clock assertion is used.

An actual SPA browser journey loads running facts, holds terminal GETs, navigates to Completed and returns to the cached failed Run; Runtime/tool request counts are exactly initial=1, state-change=2, reentry=3.

independent_review.initial_finding: Per-attempt entry invalidation caused quadratic QueryCache scans on complete retained histories.
independent_review.disposition: Entry and changed-Stage invalidation are now batched; a real QueryCache scale regression pins bounded passes.
independent_review.final_result: No additional actionable findings in the revised lifecycle, cancellation, cache-family or scale paths.

intermediate_failures: New regression cases first failed against the original hook, demonstrating the stale-page-entry defect.
The initial implementation was revised after independent review found per-attempt cache scans; no such implementation was marked complete.
Focused retry assertions initially observed the in-flight stale notice before retries finished; the tests now await the actual read error before asserting the bounded attempt count.
The first complete lint/UI attempt reported an unused fireEvent import in the new tests; it was removed and both full commands passed on the final implementation.
